candidate_decisions.reason: The trusted pericope nomination has an exact focus carrier for the clear-road prophetic facet and exact 19:43 carriers for knowledge, marking, guidance, leading, following, tracking, and the straight road. All eight candidate branches land through distinct carrier-trigger contacts; the native reading remains bounded to the declared pericope.

The trusted nomination supplies exact focus carriers for Book, messenger, prophet, and low sound, plus exact context carriers for tongue, private counsel, and calling. Their contacts form a specific movement from public address through confidential reception to carried record; all six candidate branches land.

The exact assigned HFT trace covers 19:41, 19:51, and 19:54, supplies before/after readings and all four traced branches, and returns through mukhlaṣan. Its legacy_unbound provenance and unresolved context branch records qualify the result but do not suppress the attributed comparison.

The exact assigned HFT trace covers 19:42, 19:43, and 19:51, names each speech, reception, knowledge, guidance, messenger, and prophet role, and gives a changed relay reading with focus returns. The legacy_unbound qualification is retained as attribution.

The exact assigned HFT trace covers the announced and completed withdrawal in 19:48-19:49, the gift and prophetic making, and the focus return in 19:51. All five branches land; its exploratory causal arrow is preserved as attributed rather than converted into a lexical gloss.

The exact assigned HFT trace joins the focus predicate and messenger title to the immediately following call, nearness, and confidential-converse scene. All five branches have exact carriers or attributed context coordinates and return through the focus; legacy_unbound source identity remains visible.

The exact assigned HFT trace connects the focus particularization to the gift of Aaron as brother and prophet. The four branches, including the two unresolved contextual records, land with the before/after restriction that particularization concerns source and allegiance rather than social solitude.

The exact assigned HFT trace covers the closing collective in 19:58, links selection and prophetic inclusion to recitation and bodily response, and returns to mukhlaṣan. All six branches land as attributed context or supplied focus evidence, with the legacy_unbound qualification retained.

The exact HFT outlier has a concrete 19:51-to-19:58 trace, a changed spatial reading, and explicit containment limiting it to a sequence-level inversion. The 19:57 raised-place counter-reading is retained, so the exploratory result is qualified rather than excluded.

findings.title: Prophetic office as a marked route
findings.claim: The prophetic title in 19:51 meets the knowledge, guidance, following, and straight-road wording of 19:43, so Moses's office can also be perceived as an open route whose direction is marked and followed step by step.
findings.mechanism: The clear-road facet carried by the focus prophet title contacts the separate 19:43 carriers for knowledge, a pointing mark, guidance, leading, following, and the straight road. Their contact turns the two titles from static labels into a local relation between a disclosed route, a guide at its front, and a traveler who follows it.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see how a prophetic office gives direction without losing the plain claim that Moses is a prophet and messenger.
findings.containment: The ordinary office reading remains primary. This is a bounded pericope image, not a claim that the whole surah is a road system and not a replacement of the person-and-office meanings.

epistemic.reason: The channel nomination is trusted and every carrier is present, but most context evidence is lean branch-image material rather than full target morphology; the synthesis is therefore qualified.

branch_activations.facet_statement: following after
branch_activations.carrier: ٱتَّبِعْنِى carries following another person along a route.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The separate guide and straight-road occurrences in 19:43 supply a route worth following.
branch_activations.activation: Following contacts guidance and the road, making the focus prophet title the office of a guideable route rather than an isolated honorific.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Moses's prophetic office is heard as a route that can be followed after a guide.
branch_activations.boundary: The occurrence does not by itself establish every possible following or imitation meaning outside this route relation.

branch_activations.facet_statement: stepwise tracking
branch_activations.carrier: The imperative to follow supplies the movement of tracking after a trace.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Guidance and the straight road make the following directional and sequential.
branch_activations.activation: A following act contacts a marked road and a guide, so progress is legible as taking one disclosed trace after another.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The office carries a stepwise path of reception and following.
branch_activations.boundary: No physical trail or complete travel narrative is being asserted.

branch_activations.facet_statement: the straight road
branch_activations.carrier: صِرَٰطًا سَوِيًّا carries an open, straight route.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus word نَّبِيًّا supplies the title whose road facet is being returned to.
branch_activations.activation: The explicit road in 19:43 supplies the concrete route image that the focus prophet title can carry.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Prophecy is locally colored as a clear way toward an intended destination.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not turn the focus title into the lexical noun for a road.

findings.title: A message moving through voice and record
findings.claim: The focus titles can be read as one relay: a message is called and carried, received in a low confidential voice, and preserved in the Book so that it can travel beyond the first hearer.
findings.mechanism: The focus Book, messenger, and prophet occurrences contact the pericope's speech, calling, tongue, private counsel, and repeated Book-entry forms. The added remembering facet also meets the good-name outcome in 19:50, so the communication is not limited to an audible moment but can become durable public remembrance.
findings.reader_payoff: The paired titles become an operating chain of disclosure, address, reception, and transmission rather than two adjacent honorifics.
findings.containment: The focus still plainly presents Moses in the Book as messenger and prophet. The relay is a local contextual image; it does not claim that every prophetic utterance is private, that sound must be faint, or that the surrounding ayat are reducible to one communication scheme.

epistemic.reason: The trusted nomination has exact carriers and context surfaces, while the contextual branch images and their synthesis remain a qualified interpretation of lean pericope evidence.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Çekirdek, bir gönderenden bir alıcıya içerik taşıyan ileti bağını kurar.
branch_activations.carrier: رَسُولًا carries a messenger who bears content from a sender to a receiver.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Speech, calling, and confidential counsel supply distinct acts and settings through which content can move.
branch_activations.activation: The messenger occurrence contacts the separate voice and counsel occurrences, making the office a carrier within an actual relay.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Moses's messenger title becomes the outward-bearing link of a disclosed message.
branch_activations.boundary: The carrier image does not decide whether the word names the person or the message in every use.

branch_activations.facet_statement: İşlemin ürünü, yazılmış metin veya üzerinde bu metnin bulunduğu sayfa ya da kitaptır.

branch_activations.activation: The focus Book contacts the repeated entry frame, so the message relay has a written carrier that outlasts the immediate voice.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The office is presented inside a record that preserves and transmits the name and message-bearing role.
branch_activations.boundary: The supplied branch is writing and written text; it is not a claim about every legal or contractual sense of the root.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Ses yüksek veya şiddetli değil, hafif ve güç fark edilir niteliktedir.

branch_activations.independent_trigger: The pericope supplies failed hearing, a call, and confidential counsel as distinct sound conditions.
branch_activations.activation: The low-sound facet contacts the call and private counsel, making hiddenness a condition of transmission rather than its cancellation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The message can begin in a voice that is intimate or difficult to hear and still move outward through the relay.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus does not lexically assert that a prophet's voice is always faint.

branch_activations.facet_statement: conveying a message by tongue
branch_activations.carrier: لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ carries the tongue as a vehicle by which a message or good name is delivered.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus messenger and prophet titles supply the offices that can bear the delivered message.
branch_activations.activation: The tongue occurrence contacts the two focus offices, connecting public speech and remembered name to the act of carrying.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The relay has a human-speaking outlet as well as its private point of reception.
branch_activations.boundary: The source image is not a claim that the focus word means tongue.

branch_activations.facet_statement: private counsel

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus titles hold together confidential reception and public delivery.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The relay stretches from a projected call to a message carried through a person and a record.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Kişinin olumlu biçimde anılmasıyla yayılan iyi ün ve övgüdür.
branch_activations.carrier: ٱذْكُرْ carries the act of bringing Moses into spoken remembrance.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The preceding tongue of truth and good-name wording supplies the public-remembrance outcome.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The communication chain ends not only in sound but in durable, publicly carried remembrance.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus imperative remains an act of mention; the honor and good-name facet is a contextual result, not its sole lexical meaning.

findings.title: The distinguishing predicate
findings.claim: The repeated Book-entry frame keeps the messenger-prophet office stable while changing the predicate before it, making mukhlaṣan the word that identifies Moses's distinctive mode of commission rather than a spare commendation.
findings.mechanism: The focus predicate contacts the complete-soundness predicate in 19:41 and the promise-fulfillment predicate in 19:54, while the repeated formula and the promise occurrence keep the comparison functional. The changing middle slot therefore explains how the same office can be qualified differently for each named figure.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can feel why the sentence gives mukhlaṣan its own work before naming the two offices.
findings.containment: The ordinary sense of being selected or purified remains intact. The comparison does not prove that every formula variation has a fixed theory or erase the live alternative that the predicates are simply different honorific descriptions.

epistemic.reason: The HFT provides exact anchors, roles, before/after readings, and focus return, but its reader identity is legacy_unbound and the context branch identities are not independently lexicon-resolved.

findings.title: Disclosure becoming guided movement
findings.claim: Within the supplied pericope, messenger and prophet name a relay in which disclosed knowledge is voiced so that a hearer can receive direction and move along a guided path.
findings.mechanism: The HFT trace places the focus messenger and prophet carriers beside speech and failed hearing in 19:42, then beside knowledge and guidance in 19:43. The contrast between a receiver that cannot hear and knowledge that has arrived to the speaker makes the two focus titles functionally connected to address, reception, and guidance.
findings.reader_payoff: The office pair becomes newly legible as a process that carries knowledge toward a hearer and a direction toward a follower.
findings.containment: The plain statement that Moses is an elçi and peygamber remains recoverable. The relay is attributed to the exact HFT trace; the no-value connection around 19:42 is retained as a limitation, and the packet does not claim that the Abraham dialogue alone defines Moses's offices.

epistemic.reason: The trace has complete supplied Arabic anchors and exact word indices, but the reader identity is legacy_unbound and context morphology is not independently supplied.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Çekirdek, bir gönderenden bir alıcıya içerik taşıyan ileti bağını kurar.

branch_activations.activation: The messenger carrier contacts those distinct acts, turning the office into a transmission link.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Moses's messenger title carries disclosure outward toward a guided recipient.
branch_activations.boundary: This is an attributed pericope mechanism, not a claim that the title lexically contains the whole chain.

findings.title: Release opening into commission
findings.claim: The preceding withdrawal and the gift that follows let mukhlaṣan be heard as an image of extraction from a retaining bond, opening a divinely granted commission rather than describing only inward purity.
findings.mechanism: The focus release-from-entanglement facet contacts Abraham's announced and completed withdrawal in 19:48-19:49, then the gift, making, and prophetic office that follow. The sequence supplies a carrier, a transition, and a new commission; the causal arrow remains the HFT reader's attributed inference.
findings.reader_payoff: The focus predicate gains a before-and-after shape: something binding has been left, and a granted future can take hold.
findings.containment: The primary selected-or-purified reading remains intact. The surrounding sequence belongs explicitly to Abraham and is not asserted as a direct historical cause of Moses's state; simple temporal succession remains live.

epistemic.reason: The HFT trace is exact and complete at its named anchors, but its reader identity is legacy_unbound, its context branch records are unresolved or attributed, and its confidence is exploratory.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Kurtulan kişi ya da şey önceden bir bağa, tuzağa veya engelleyici duruma takılmıştır.
branch_activations.carrier: مُخْلَصًا carries the supplied release-from-entanglement image.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The preceding ayat name withdrawal, its completion, a gift, and the making of prophets.
branch_activations.activation: The focus release facet contacts that ordered sequence, so the predicate can picture extraction opening into a new commission.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Moses's state can also be perceived as freedom from a retaining bond before a granted office takes hold.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus form is not reduced to a generic escape verb and the Abraham sequence is not asserted as direct causation.

branch_activations.carrier: أَعْتَزِلُكُمْ is attributed as announced separation from an obstructing affiliation.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus release carrier and the completed withdrawal in 19:49 supply the before-and-after relation.
branch_activations.activation: Announced separation contacts the focus release facet as the first movement out of a binding social relation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus predicate receives a preparatory image of intended release.
branch_activations.boundary: The context branch remains attributed and is not given an invented gloss.

branch_activations.carrier: ٱعْتَزَلَهُمْ is attributed as completed withdrawal.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The earlier announced withdrawal supplies the intention that this occurrence completes.
branch_activations.activation: Completed separation contacts the focus release image and creates the transition before the gift and prophetic making.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Release is seen as an enacted change rather than an unfulfilled intention.
branch_activations.boundary: The sequence is contextual evidence and does not force a causal claim about the focus person.

branch_activations.carrier: وَهَبْنَا is attributed as a freely given gift without exchange.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Completed withdrawal precedes the gift and is followed by prophetic making.
branch_activations.activation: Gift contacts release as the new future that follows separation, rather than as compensation earned by it.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The commission can be seen as granted after release, not manufactured by the released person.
branch_activations.boundary: The HFT does not establish that separation earns or mechanically causes the gift.

branch_activations.carrier: جَعَلْنَا is attributed as causing a person to enter a state.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The gift and the following prophet office identify the new state that is produced in the sequence.
branch_activations.activation: Making contacts the focus release and the prophetic title, giving the transition a granted agent and a new status.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The released-to-commission movement ends in a state bestowed rather than self-created.
branch_activations.boundary: No unprovided branch gloss or independent morphology is added to the context occurrence.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Tanrı'dan gelen haberleri insanlara bildiren yetkili bir elçi söz konusudur.
branch_activations.carrier: نَبِيًّا is attributed as the divine-news-bearing prophetic office produced after the gift.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The making occurrence supplies the state transition that the prophetic office completes.
branch_activations.activation: The prophetic carrier contacts making and the focus release facet, giving the extracted state a commissioned destination.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Release opens into a divinely conferred prophetic commission in the local sequence.
branch_activations.boundary: This context office is not transferred as a direct lexical definition of mukhlaṣan.

findings.title: Restricted converse opening outward
findings.claim: The focus predicate and messenger title can also be read through the next ayah as a movement into restricted converse: Moses is brought near for confidential speech, and what is received can then be borne outward.
findings.mechanism: The focus particularization and arrival facets contact 19:52's call, brought-near, and private-counsel occurrences, while the focus messenger carrier supplies the outward direction. The transitive nearness keeps divine agency visible, and the private-to-public relation is the HFT's attributed inference.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees a hinge between intimate reception and public mission without losing the ordinary titles.
findings.containment: The plain reading still says that Moses was selected or purified and was messenger and prophet. The nearness can also be an honor independent of mission; no general secrecy or complete causal chain is claimed.

epistemic.reason: The HFT supplies exact 19:51 and 19:52 anchors and a strong trace, but reader identity is legacy_unbound and context morphology is not independently supplied.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Hareket eden kişi ya da şey belirtilen hedefe ulaşır.

branch_activations.activation: The focus arrival facet contacts the next scene's brought-near movement, turning selection into access that is reached and granted.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Moses's selected state opens into a privileged arrival before the outward mission.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus predicate is not reduced to a general verb of arrival.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus state can be perceived as restricted access that feeds mission.
branch_activations.boundary: Particularization is not claimed to mean isolation from every person or audience.

branch_activations.boundary: Confidential converse is not asserted to be the only form or audience of the mission.

findings.title: Particularization without isolation
findings.claim: The particularization carried by mukhlaṣan need not mean that Moses's commission is socially solitary: the next ayah places a freely gifted brother and fellow prophet inside the same mission.
findings.mechanism: The focus particularization facet contacts the gift, brotherhood, and prophetic-office occurrences of 19:53. The result separates exclusive source or allegiance from team size, so a selected relation can remain particular while prophetic labor is shared.
findings.reader_payoff: A potentially isolating reading is opened and then bounded by the very next gifted relationship.
findings.containment: The focus can still carry distinction and being set apart. The finding does not decide whether Aaron is merely auxiliary or fully coextensive in mission; it only prevents social solitude from being forced by particularization.

epistemic.reason: The HFT supplies exact focus and 19:53 anchors and a clear before/after relation, but its reader identity and unresolved context branches require attributed qualification.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: Selected intimacy can be shared in prophetic work while remaining particular in source and allegiance.

findings.title: Selection verified by yielding
findings.claim: The closing collective lets Moses's selected state be perceived as heightened receptivity: the specially gathered prophets are identified by yielding when the divine signs are recited.
findings.mechanism: The focus particularization and prophet carriers contact 19:58's selection, guidance, recitation, falling, and prostration. Selection is therefore connected to a bodily response that receives signs, rather than only to insulated elevation.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees a test of selectedness in responsiveness, not only a status placed above others.
findings.containment: The focus still says that Moses was selected or purified and was a messenger-prophet. The HFT inference that the collective includes Moses remains attributed; the closing ayah may also be read as a group summary without defining mukhlaṣan specifically.

epistemic.reason: The HFT gives exact 19:51 and 19:58 coordinates and a complete trace, but the reader identity is legacy_unbound and several context branch records are unresolved.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: Selection is newly perceptible as responsiveness enacted through descent.
branch_activations.boundary: The fall is not asserted as a literal event involving Moses in the focus ayah itself.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus's selectedness remains live while its contextual effect is downward receptivity.
branch_activations.boundary: The attributed context does not replace the focus's ordinary selected-status predicate.

findings.title: A downward geometry of selection
findings.claim: The pericope can give selection a downward geometry: the specially brought-near prophets are the ones who fall low before the signs, so distinction is accompanied by surrender rather than protected distance.
findings.mechanism: The focus particularization contacts the closing selection and the attributed fall and prostration sequence. The resulting spatial inversion is a sequence-level inference; the supplied 19:57 raised-place contact remains visible as counter-evidence rather than being erased.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hold selection and descent in the same picture without treating descent as a denial of selection.
findings.containment: This is not a lexical gloss of mukhlaṣan and not a claim that selectedness always means physical lowering. 19:57's raised-place wording remains a live counter-reading; the outlier is exploratory and bounded to the supplied 19:51-to-19:58 relation.

epistemic.reason: The exact HFT outlier supplies the carriers, triggers, changed reading, and explicit containment, but its reader identity is legacy_unbound and the context branches are unresolved attributed records.

findings.title: Particularization heard as exclusive devotion
findings.claim: The explicitly added 1:5 wording gives the focus particularization a further devotional contact: being set apart can also be heard as a direction of worship toward one object rather than a statement of active self-purification.
findings.mechanism: The focus mukhlaṣan carrier meets the external occurrence إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ and its accompanying request for help. The added external ayah supplies an explicit exclusive-worship trigger that is absent from the native focus surface, creating a specific overlay beyond the pericope findings.
findings.reader_payoff: The selected state gains a directional dimension: what is set apart is not merely distinguished but oriented away from rival objects toward one worshipped referent.
findings.containment: The passive focus form remains the ordinary selected-or-purified floor; this is a qualified external resonance, not an active-morphology claim that Moses performs the act in 19:51. The external ayah does not rewrite the native pericope.

epistemic.reason: The external surface and the accepted focus facet are exact, but the overlay relation is an authored contextual inference and the external member is deliberately kept separate from native context.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus state can also be perceived as devoted orientation away from rival objects.
branch_activations.boundary: The external trigger does not change the passive form into an active verb or make 19:51 itself a prayer.

findings.title: The open route becomes a request
findings.claim: The added 1:6-1:7 request gives the focus prophet title's clear-road facet a recipient-side delta: the route Moses can guide toward is also a straight way that a community asks to be shown and distinguished from losing the way.
findings.mechanism: The focus clear-road carrier meets the external occurrences for guidance, the straight path, and the contrast with those who have gone astray. Native 19:43 already supplies a guide and road; the external overlay adds the petitioning recipient and the explicit request for direction, so it changes the relation without replacing the native finding.
findings.reader_payoff: The road image now has both a guide's outward offer and a seeker's inward request, while the focus remains a statement about Moses's office.
findings.containment: The added ayat are an overlay only. They do not make 19:51 grammatically imperative or turn the whole pericope into Fatiha commentary; the focus's messenger-prophet reading and the native 19:43 route contact remain intact.

epistemic.reason: The external occurrences and focus branch facet are exact, while the added petition-to-office relation is an authored overlay inference kept separate from native context.

branch_activations.boundary: The added Fatiha wording does not become part of the focus ayah's grammar or native pericope frame.
